description: This file contains a Parser class responsible for parsing Excel formulas and formulas in spreadsheets, converting tokens into a parse tree, and generating reverse polish notation (RPN). It also handles formulas referencing external sheets, ranges, and various cell references, with emphasis on formula syntax, token matching, and conversion to PTG (Parse Token Group) binary formats. The code is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library specifically for writing XLS files.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A class for parsing Excel formulas, generating parse trees, and converting formulas into PTG (Parse Token Group) binary format for XLS file writing. Handles external references, ranges, functions, and operators within formulas.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse a formula string and generate a parse tree.

methods.name: condition
methods.description: Parses conditional expressions involving comparison operators.

methods.name: expression
methods.description: Parses expressions, handling addition, subtraction, and string concatenation.

methods.name: parenthesizedExpression
methods.description: Wraps an expression in parentheses to preserve grouping.

methods.name: term
methods.description: Parses multiplication and division operations.

methods.name: fact
methods.description: Parses individual factors, including references, ranges, numbers, functions, and parenthesized expressions.

methods.name: func
methods.description: Parses function calls, handling argument lists and function validation.

methods.name: createTree
methods.description: Creates a parse tree node with a value and left/right subtrees.

methods.name: toReversePolish
methods.description: Converts a parse tree into reverse polish notation (RPN) string.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if a token matches known operators, references, ranges, errors, functions, or logical constants.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a token into its corresponding PTG binary representation based on its type.

methods.name: convertNumber
methods.description: Converts numeric tokens into PTG ints or floats.

methods.name: convertBool
methods.description: Converts boolean tokens into PTG bools.

methods.name: convertString
methods.description: Converts string tokens into PTG string format.

methods.name: convertFunction
methods.description: Converts function tokens into PTG function references, handling argument counts.

methods.name: convertRange2d
methods.description: Converts 2D cell ranges into PTG area tokens.

methods.name: convertRange3d
methods.description: Converts 3D ranges (with sheet references) into PTG area3d tokens.

methods.name: convertRef2d
methods.description: Converts individual cell references into PTG reference tokens.

methods.name: convertRef3d
methods.description: Converts 3D references (with sheet references) into PTG reference3d tokens.

methods.name: convertError
methods.description: Converts Excel error tokens into PTG error codes.

methods.name: getRefIndex
methods.description: Gets or adds a sheet reference index for external references.

methods.name: getSheetIndex
methods.description: Retrieves sheet index for a given sheet name from external sheets.

methods.name: setExtSheet
methods.description: Sets external sheet name and index for reference handling.

methods.name: cellToPackedRowcol
methods.description: Converts an Excel cell reference to packed row/column binary format.

methods.name: rangeToPackedRange
methods.description: Converts a range string to packed row/column range.

methods.name: cellToRowcol
methods.description: Converts a cell reference to numeric row and column indices with relative info.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Advances the parser to the next token.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Matches tokens against known syntactic elements such as operators, references, ranges, errors, functions.
